name: Joshua Rotenberg
body: Order.co is building what I'd want as a customer: a way for businesses to buy what they need without the purchase process becoming a job of its own. I build AI agents and automated workflows for my own clients today, replacing manual operational steps end to end, so the agentic direction of the platform is something I can explain to an operations or finance lead in plain terms and help them get value from.

The core of this role, retaining and growing a book while NRR carries the score, is where my track record is strongest. At Birdeye I managed 15-20 reseller partners and retained all but one by tracking utilization in Salesforce and stepping in on adoption gaps before they became churn. At Accelo I ranked top three in sales while quota roughly doubled, working directly with C-suite leaders at professional-services firms on how their operations should run. At Wix I held 120% of sales targets while onboarding 25+ clients a month. I haven't worked inside procurement or AP software specifically, but I've spent my career learning a customer's operations quickly and turning that into expansion.
I'd welcome a conversation about growing Order.co's book of business. I'm available at 303-726-5037 or jrotnbrg@gmail.com.
